tools.description: Submits structured agent friction, schema mismatch, auth wall, broken route, or feature request feedback for any of the 24 LaunchFiles portfolio products or LaunchFiles itself. Recurring friction (>= 2 reports) or blocker severity automatically compiles a proposed AX Repair Work Order.

tools.name: get_portfolio_agent_feedback_summary
tools.description: Retrieves the central LaunchFiles portfolio agent feedback ledger, per-product friction counts, blocker counts, and proposed AX Repair Work Orders across all 24 portfolio products.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: launchfiles_standalone_design_ux_radar_free, launchfiles_standalone_search_repair_radar_free · Private data: launchfiles_standalone_design_ux_radar_free, launchfiles_poll_agent_key · Public sink: launchfiles_standalone_design_ux_radar_free, launchfiles_billing_create_checkout, launchfiles_standalone_page_draft_short, submit_agent_feedback · Destructive: run_ux_radar_proof.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: launchfiles_standalone_design_ux_radar_free, launchfiles_standalone_search_repair_radar_free · Private data: launchfiles_standalone_design_ux_radar_free, launchfiles_poll_agent_key · Public sink: launchfiles_standalone_design_ux_radar_free, launchfiles_billing_create_checkout, launchfiles_standalone_page_draft_short, submit_agent_feedback · Destructive: run_ux_radar_proof

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_vertical_redesign_spec" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Retrieves the autonomous vertical redesign specification, locked theme token pack, and pre-generation domain lock for a vertical SaaS product." → after: "Retrieves or compiles the fail-closed vertical redesign specification, parameterized environmental design physics, and launchfiles_domain_lock_v3 artifact for a registered slug or caller-supplied domain_lock_manifest."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
